inputs.question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?

queries:
SELECT COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) as genre_count
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 10
) as customer_genres
